preconditions.description: The number of stones is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
Each stone has edges with lengths between 1 and 10^9, inclusive.

postconditions.description: Zahar will choose between 1 and 2 stones.

postconditions.expression: All integers in the chosen stones list are distinct and between 1 and n, inclusive.
postconditions.description: The chosen stones are numbered from 1 to n.

postconditions.expression: The volume of the largest inscribed sphere is maximized.
postconditions.description: The goal is to maximize the volume of the sphere that can be inscribed in the chosen stones.
